R12.why: A flow without an end event leaves its last element without a way out, which R13 reports.

R17.why: A name that is a vague verb alone has no object, which ACT-02 of the optional rule package checks too.

R23.why: «Nueva actividad», the default name, is no infinitive and object, which ACT-02 of the optional rule package checks in Spanish.

EST-05.why: A loop with no way out cannot reach an end event either, which EST-01 reports.

EST-01.why: Without a dead end (R13), the only path that never reaches an end is a loop with no way out, which EST-05 reports.

COM-22.why: A return straight into an activity gives it a second way in, which R01 reports.
